text:
maria: Quick thread - I ran the unit-econ sweep across new 7B/13B/14B candidates with int8/int4 configs. Need a short recommendation we can hand to GTM and platform routing.
suresh: nice. high level numbers? latency / p50 and cost per 1k tokens?
olivia: pulled a tiny summary from the bench job (sampled 1k prompts, 1.5k token avg). roughs below:
```
model,quant,p50_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens,winrate_on-qa
7B-int8, int8, 60ms, $0.22, 0.78
7B-int4, int4, 55ms, $0.14, 0.72
13B-int8, int8, 120ms, $0.38, 0.88
14B-int8, int8, 150ms, $0.44, 0.91
```
olivia: winrate = proportion of eval prompts where response >= baseline quality threshold (internal QA score >= 0.8).
jamal: interesting — 7B-int8 is obviously cheapest-latency sweet spot. 14B wins quality but at 2x cost and ~2.5x latency vs 7B.
maria: can we quantify marginal quality lift vs marginal cost? GTM asks for "what do we sell as standard vs premium".
suresh: rough delta calc: going 7B-int8 -> 14B-int8 gives +0.13 winrate for +$0.22 per 1k tokens -> ~0.59 winrate-per-dollar-point (not a great business metric but illustrative).
olivia: also from evals: failures/regressions mostly on long-context factuality and code generation. 14B-int8 reduces hallucination markers by ~35% vs 7B.
jamal: product constraints: free tier latency budget 100ms p50, standard 150ms, premium 250ms. So 7B-int8 fits free & standard, 13B-int8 only standard/premium, 14B-int8 premium only.
maria: recommend mapping + routing policies:

- free tier: default 7B-int8; fallback 7B-int4 for spikes (cost saver)
- standard (paid): default 13B-int8; can fall back to 7B-int8 if latency SLOs violated
- premium/enterprise: default 14B-int8 pinned; allow 13B-int8 routing for cost-sensitive customers

suresh: add quantization nuance: 7B-int4 is lowest cost but quality drop is visible on summarization tasks. Reserve int4 for high-throughput cached routes only.
olivia: suggested rollout plan for GTM and product copy:

1) Canary: enable routing on 10% of standard traffic to 13B-int8, monitor eval score delta and cost delta for 2 weeks
2) Measure: daily eval samples (200 prompts) + automated quality regressions; alert if winrate drops >3% or hallucination rate increases >5%
3) Promote: after stable 2 weeks, flip standard to 13B-int8 default; update docs with latency/cost expected numbers

jamal: for sales/GTN messaging: "Standard: balanced latency & quality (13B-int8). Premium: highest-quality model (14B-int8) with dedicated throughput options." Keep cost numbers in dev-only sheet.
maria: one-off note on caching: prefix KV caching helps 13B/14B fairly well — effective token cost drops ~12% on our conversational traces.
suresh: ops ask: autoscaler should allow burst to cheaper variants when queueing latency > target for 30s. I'll open infra ticket.
maria: can someone draft the two-line blurb GTM can paste into docs? olivia?
olivia: draft: "Standard: 13B-int8 — balanced latency and answer quality suitable for most applications. Premium: 14B-int8 — best-in-class quality for critical tasks; choose dedicated capacity for predictable throughput." (I can iterate.)
jamal: approve. also add a short internal playbook entry: when eval regressions >4% escalate to ML team + disable new quant config.
eval-bot: Automated eval summary for 1858765432: delta_winrate_standard_canary = +0.05, avg_p50_delta = +45ms, cost_delta = +$0.16/1k
maria: perfect. action items: (1) Suresh open autoscale ticket, (2) Olivia push GTM blurb + doc snippet, (3) Jamal add rollback thresholds in runbook. I'll consolidate and send to PMs.
suresh: on it.
olivia: working on blurb now.
jamal: adding rollback thresholds.
maria: thanks all. short and actionable — we'll share this with growth and sales later today. :rocket:
